Example pedons for the FAO-Unesco legend

Source: R/key-fao.R
make_fao_example.Rd

Small synthetic profiles written for the tests and examples, one per major soil grouping and one per soil unit of the Revised Legend (FAO 1988), built from the key's numbers (no profile of the book is copied). A grouping's example keys to its own grouping without an undecided gate before it; a unit's example (built on its grouping's) keys to its own unit without an undecided grouping or unit before it. With near_miss = TRUE, the same profile with one printed number of its gate crossed (a Luvisol with a base saturation of 45 % in its lower B, a Histosol with 35 cm of peat, a Lithic Leptosol with its rock at 11 cm), which keys elsewhere; a unit whose gate has no printed number has no near miss. They are not real profiles.

Usage

make_fao_example(code = "HS", edition = c("1988", "1974"), near_miss = FALSE)

Arguments

code

The code of a major soil grouping of 1988 ("HS", "AT", "LP", "VR", "FL", "SC", "GL", "AN", "AR", "RG", "PZ", "PT", "FR", "PL", "SN", "GR", "CH", "KS", "PH", "PD", "GY", "CL", "NT", "AL", "AC", "LV", "LX", "CM"), or of one of its 153 soil units ("HSi", "LVx", "CMe" ...); with edition = "1974", of a major soil group of 1974 ("O", "I", "V", "J", "Z", "G", "T", "Q", "R", "U", "E", "P", "F", "W", "S", "M", "C", "K", "H", "D", "X", "Y", "N", "A", "L", "B") or of one of its 106 soil units ("Ox", "Lc", "Be" ...).

edition

"1988" (default) or "1974" (since v0.9.389).

near_miss

TRUE for the near miss of the grouping.

Value

A PedonRecord.

See also

classify_fao.

Examples

p <- make_fao_example("PH")
p$horizons[, c("designation", "top_cm", "bottom_cm", "bs_pct")]
#>    designation top_cm bottom_cm bs_pct
#>         <char>  <num>     <num>  <num>
#> 1:         Ah1      0        20     70
#> 2:         Ah2     20        40     65
#> 3:          Bw     40        90     60
#> 4:           C     90       140     60
classify_fao(make_fao_example("LVx"), on_missing = "silent")$name
#> [1] "Chromic Luvisols"
classify_fao(make_fao_example("Fx", edition = "1974"), edition = "1974",
             on_missing = "silent")$name
#> [1] "Xanthic Ferralsols"
